consent.title: {client} wants to access your account
consent.titleFallback: An app wants to access your account
consent.intro: If you allow it, {client} will be able to act on onmangekoi on your behalf, from the conversation where you use it.
consent.redirect: After you answer, you will be sent back to {target}.
consent.canTitle: What the app will be able to do

can.read: Read your sessions, your lists and their rankings.
can.create: Create sessions and lists for you.
can.act: Vote, launch or close a session and confirm a choice on your behalf.

consent.trust: The app will act with the same rights as you on onmangekoi, and can learn the email linked to your account. It will never see your password. Only allow apps you know and added yourself.
consent.anonymousHint: This account is not linked to any email. Link one from your account page so you don’t lose access: inactive anonymous accounts are deleted after 90 days.
consent.revokeHint: You can disconnect this app at any time from your account page.

errors.missing: This link does not contain an authorization request. Start the connection again from the app that sent you here.
errors.invalid: This authorization request has expired or is no longer valid. Start the connection again from the app that sent you here.
errors.decisionFailed: Your answer could not be sent. The request may have expired: start the connection again from the app.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.description: The AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT…) you have allowed to use your account.
connectedApps.howTo: To connect an assistant, add this MCP server to its connectors, then allow access when it asks:
connectedApps.disconnectFailed: Disconnecting failed. Try again in a moment.
connectedApps.unavailable: The list of connected apps is unavailable right now.
